why: Bonus programs/events that pay extra for things you do anyway. Edit progress from screenshots. `next` adds the reward to matching agent offers and lists market goals on sell/trade steps. reward_isk = ISK value of ONE completion (? = guessed), market = counts when you trade/sell on the market, careers = agent offers (by career) that complete it, safe = false means it needs null-sec/Pochven/PvP: never routed.
